title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

title: Chief Operating Officer (COO)
description:
Overview

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We are scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform how food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils to create a liveable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We are partnering with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders and are growing fast. Our culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We are proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil where the real climate impact happens.

About The Role

Role: COO to lead go-to-market strategy for novel mineral-based carbon removal products across agricultural and mining sectors, and to evolve our operational backbone. You will oversee the entire value chain—from mineral inputs and field operations to the internal science engine and technology roadmap. This is a senior role where bold strategy meets operational precision to drive transformational scale.

Location & Travel: Hybrid, with travel in Brazil. Language skills: Portuguese, English (fluent). Start date: Ideally Q3/Q4 2025.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and scale a novel carbon removal product from early traction to national impact in agriculture and mining; a 1-100 leadership role requiring bold strategy and relentless execution.
  • Lead the design and execution of a world-class ERW deployment operation across Brazil with scalability in mind.
  • Translate carbon and climate goals into clear operational strategies and regional delivery models.
  • Drive continuous improvement via operational KPIs, systemisation, and data-driven performance.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Impact Officer, Head of Operations, and VP of Science to align field strategy with scientific standards and operational goals.
  • Lead the integration of field deployment, scientific integrity, and operational scaling to ensure product-market fit.
  • Build cross-functional alignment to ensure the product offers agronomic value while meeting carbon certification requirements; orchestrate the 1-100 scale-up journey.
  • Oversee the sourcing, logistics, and deployment of rock powder from mine to farm; ensure compliance with carbon standards and farmer requirements.
  • Support legal to uphold integrity in carbon reporting and environmental impact.
  • Lead a large and growing team across Brazil and globally; collaborate with Carbon, Science, and Technology teams and strategic partners.
Team & Culture
  • Build a leadership culture that is entrepreneurial, fast, and accountable; turn high performers into high-impact owners.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow high-performing operations teams across Brazil and globally.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, and impact-driven execution.
  • Empower regional managers and technical leads to deliver quality projects at scale.
You can be a Rock-Star if you have Core Skills & Experience
  • 10+ years of senior leadership in operations, supply chain, or agribusiness in Brazil and in high-growth or startup contexts.
  • You have scaled something from messy beginnings to market success—ideally as a founder, GM, or CEO. You know what product-market fit looks like, and how to turn it into category leadership.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building scalable systems from the ground up.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills in Portuguese and English.
Key Qualities
  • Visionary but pragmatic—able to balance long-term strategy with daily urgency.
  • A confident, emotionally intelligent leader who knows when to listen, act, and delegate.
  • Comfortable navigating complexity, ambiguity, and rapid growth.
  • Hands-on, humble, and willing to “get your boots dirty” when needed.
  • Passion for sustainability, tropical agriculture, and climate innovation.
Bonus Points
  • Experience in impact-driven sectors such as climate, carbon markets, or regenerative agriculture is a big plus.
  • Deep knowledge and network of Brazilian agriculture, logistics, or mining.
  • Experience building strategic and commercial partnerships in Brazil, within agriculture.
  • Experience with building and scaling tech for agriculture.
Living Our Values
  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering trust and collaboration.
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our mission to address climate change.
  • Compensation: Competitive compensation philosophy discussed in the first interview to manage expectations fairly.
  • Share options to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget; Hybrid Remote around Sao Paulo.
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance.
  • 40 days annual leave.
  • The opportunity to be autonomous and belong to a vision.
  • Bi-annual offsites in Brazil.
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity.
Application Process

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We’re seeking a strategic and forward-thinking Principal Product Manager to shape the future of our sales systems and tools. In this highly autonomous, individual contributor role, you’ll lead initiatives that enhance the productivity and effectiveness of our frontline sales teams including field, administrative, and tele-sales functions.

You’ll take a step back to uncover foundational opportunities that drive long-term impact across the business. Your work will help unify sales workflows, elevate user experience, and influence how we scale and support sales organizations.

  • Develop deep expertise in how frontline sales teams operate by identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and unmet needs through research and partnership.

  • Collaborate with partners in product, engineering, design, data, and sales operations to frame high-impact problems and explore solutions. Connect business strategy, user needs, and technical capabilities to influence product direction and priorities.
  • Advocate for changes across process, technology, and organizational practices that deliver meaningful impact.
  • Clearly articulate trade-offs and opportunities to senior stakeholders and help guide resource allocation across teams.
What We’re Looking For
  • Proven success leading strategic product initiatives in complex environments, ideally at the principal level or equivalent.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence decisions and align stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong product intuition, user empathy, and a systems-thinking mindset.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and thriving in a role with high autonomy and broad scope
Preferred Qualifications
  • Background in B2B sales systems, CRM platforms, or internal tools supporting sales teams.
  • Experience leading discovery and research in enterprise or cross-functional environments
  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, with the ability to collaborate closely with designers to deliver intuitive and effective sales tools.
  • Ability to evaluate technical solutions in collaboration with engineering teams and make informed decisions that balance user needs, scalability, and complexity.
  • Advanced degree in business, operations, or a related field is a plus—especially if it supports strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, and organizational change. Equivalent experience is equally valued.
More about you
  • You´re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality.
  • You´re motivated by building world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world.
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;

  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

title: Machine Learning (ML) Ops Engineer
description:
Location: Fully remote

Employment type: Part-time

About Bizmoni Corp.

Bizmoni is the worlds first AI Super App designed to help anyone earn, learn, and grow in the AI era. We are building a global, fully remote team to shape the future of financial technology. Our mission is to make powerful AI-driven financial and business tools accessible to everyone from individuals starting side hustles to enterprises scaling globally.

About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled and driven MLOps Engineer to design, automate, and optimize our machine learning infrastructure. In this role, you will play a crucial part in bridging the gap between data science and operations by streamlining our AI/ML workflows from experimentation to production.

You will collaborate closely with data scientists, data engineers, and developers to ensure our models are secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient. Your work will directly impact thousands of users worldwide by enabling real-time, AI-powered financial insights and business solutions.

If you are passionate about deploying cutting-edge ML technologies and want to be part of a mission-driven fintech startup, wed love to hear from you!

What You'll Do:
  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end machine learning infrastructure ensuring scalability, high availability, and performance.
  • Automate ML pipelines with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD frameworks.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to streamline model deployment.
  • Monitor and optimize models in production with observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for efficiency and cost.
  • Ensure compliance and security protocols for sensitive financial data.
  • Provide support and maintenance to ensure the reliability of ML applications.
What You'll Bring:
  • Proven experience as an MLOps Engineer or similar role (fintech or AI startup experience is a plus).
  • Strong programming skills in Python (preferred); familiarity with Java or Scala is a plus.
  • Experience with ML frameworks and pipeline orchestration (MLflow, Airflow, Kubeflow, or SageMaker).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Solid knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools.
  • Strong understanding of ML algorithms and their real-world applications.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a remote, cross-timezone team environment.
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
Why Youll Love Working at Bizmoni:
  • Be part of a mission-driven company building the future of AI-powered FinTech.
  • Fully remote role with a global, diverse team.
  • Equity-based compensation with the potential for future full-time opportunities.
  • Culture of innovation, collaboration, and ownership.

  • Are you open to equity-based compensation?
  • Are you able to dedicate 16 hours weekly to our project?

If your answers are YES , then we are happy to meet you!

Recruitment Process:

  1. Interview with Data Science Department Manager & TA Partner.
  2. Offer (based on final positive feedback).

description:
Head of Tax & Accouting Reporting
  • Local: Campinas

Descrição da função

Reportando-se diretamente ao CFO, o profissional será responsável pelas áreas de planejamento tributário, compliance, contencioso tributário, contabilidade e controles internos. Sua principal missão será definir e assegurar a implementação de processos robustos, alinhados à legislação vigente, garantindo segurança e conformidade contábil e fiscal.

Além disso, será responsável pela condução do roll-out dos sistemas SAP HANA, DRC, TDF/Tax One e Onesource Determination (IDT) para a Medley, assegurando que os processos de apuração, recolhimento e entrega das obrigações acessórias sejam eficazes, automatizados e aderentes às exigências legais.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Implementar a Reforma Tributária, dando o necessário suporte ao negócio para a tomada de decisões.
  • Definir estratégias fiscais que otimizem a carga tributária da empresa, respeitando a legislação vigente.
  • Monitorar alterações na legislação tributária e avaliar impactos nos negócios.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das obrigações tributárias (pagamento de impostos e entrega de obrigações acessórias), bem como implementar e manter políticas e controles internos para assegurar conformidade com normas fiscais.
  • Gerenciar eventuais processos administrativos e judiciais relacionados a tributos, atuando na defesa dos interesses da empresa, bem como acompanhar auditorias fiscais e responder a notificações de órgãos reguladores.
  • Liderar a execução contábil e garantir conformidade com políticas do Grupo Sanofi, controles internos, auditoria e requisitos SOX, assegurando a entrega dos KPIs operacionais e suporte a projetos de migração, testes de controle e auditorias internas.
  • Supervisionar e desenvolver a equipe de fechamento contábil e reporte, atuando como ponto de escalonamento, promovendo padronização de processos, resolução de pendências operacionais e implementação de melhorias sistêmicas e procedimentais.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo informações e documentação necessária.
  • Liderar a implementação e o roll-out de sistemas fiscais e contábeis (ex.: SAP HANA, DRC, TDF/Tax One, Onesource), bem como a implementação da Reforma Tributária na Medley.
  • Gerenciar a preparação e acompanhamento dos testes de controles para fins de auditoria (interna e externa), incluindo suporte em processos de SOX, quando aplicável.
  • Assegurar o suporte necessário à performance dos gerenciados, promovendo a adequada orientação por meio de treinamentos, reuniões periódicas de discussão e avaliação de assuntos pertinentes à área.
  • Assegurar a motivação da equipe e otimização de sua performance, por meio de elaboração e implementação de programas adequados de incentivos ao cumprimento dos objetivos.
Managers
  • Promover a cultura de Ética e Integridade nos Negócios em sua equipe servindo como um modelo ao garantir adequado conhecimento e cumprimento dos princípios de ética e integridade, políticas da Sanofi e códigos de conduta que regulam o mercado farmacêutico.
  • Cumprir e promover as políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) da Sanofi em relação à equipe que gerencia, nas quais inclui-se o Programa de Segurança Viária (Road Safety), com objetivo de prevenir ocorrência de acidentes, evitar riscos para a saúde, promover o bem-estar dos colaboradores e reduzir os impactos ambientais resultantes da execução de suas atividades laborais.
Sobre você
  • Experiência: 15 anos ou mais na área tributária.
  • Competências técnicas e pessoais: Gestão de Pessoas, capacidade analítica, gestão em projetos, conhecimentos de auditoria fiscal e contábil, conhecimentos em automação e tecnologia. Pró atividade, liderança, senso de urgência, senso de unidade e coletividade, conhecimento técnico nas áreas contábil e fiscal
  • Formação acadêmica: Formação Superior Completa em Contabilidade e CRC ativo, com desejável pós-graduação ou MBA na área tributária e conhecimento sistêmico.
  • Línguas: Inglês avançado,
Porque deve nos escolher?

A Medley, unidade de negócios de genéricos da Sanofi , tem como foco democratizar o acesso à saúde no Brasil, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas, principalmente, para a cardiologia, saúde feminina, doenças do sistema nervoso central e gastroenterologia. Há mais de 29 anos, oferecemos medicamentos de qualidade a milhares de brasileiros. A eficácia da Medley em produzir medicamentos genéricos é reconhecida e premiada, pois seguimos critérios de qualidade e rigor científico para oferecer o melhor para a saúde dos nossos consumidores.

Uma das nossas prioridades é melhorar a experiência das pessoas em suas jornadas de saúde, oferecendo conteúdos relevantes, campanhas educativas e serviços de apoio. Eficaz em tudo que faz,a Medley é patrocinadora do Comitê Olímpico do Brasil,e apoia o esporte e a saúde dos brasileiros.

title: Especialista de desenvolvimento node js e agentes
description:
Especialista de desenvolvimento node js e agentes

O desenvolvimento de software é o nosso coração. Os produtos da Superlógica impactam milhares de pessoas diariamente, sendo a nossa forma de ajudar o empreendedor a transformar o mundo.

Missão do Cargo

O(A) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Especialista em Node.js e Agentes será o principal responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar microsserviços e APIs de alta performance usando Node.js e a arquitetura Serverless/Cloud-Native na AWS. O foco central será a criação de Agentes de Automação e IA, utilizando padrões como o Model Context Protocol (MCP) para garantir integrações robustas e a orquestração eficiente de modelos de linguagem (LLMs) e outros serviços cognitivos.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Desenvolvimento de Agentes e MCP: Projetar, desenvolver e manter a lógica de negócio dos agentes, aplicando o Model Context Protocol (MCP) para padronização da comunicação e do contexto de execução em sistemas distribuídos.
  • Back-end em Node.js: Liderar o desenvolvimento de microsserviços e APIs escaláveis e resilientes utilizando Node.js (e TypeScript), garantindo código limpo, testável e de alta qualidade.
  • Arquitetura AWS: Implementar e gerenciar a infraestrutura de backend utilizando os principais serviços da AWS, com forte ênfase em soluções Serverless (AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, SQS/SNS).
  • Integração e Orquestração de IA: Integrar e orquestrar APIs de modelos de IA (LLMs, RAG, etc.) nos fluxos dos agentes e sistemas, otimizando a performance e o custo de inferência.
  • DevOps e Observabilidade: Trabalhar com práticas de CI/CD, monitoramento (CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) e Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), preferencialmente Terraform ou CloudFormation, para gerenciar os recursos da AWS.
  • Qualidade e Segurança: Garantir a aplicação de testes automatizados (unitários, integração e end-to-end) e práticas de segurança da informação (OWASP, autenticação/autorização) nos serviços desenvolvidos.
Requisitos Essenciais
  • Experiência sólida (mínimo de 5 anos) como Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end Sênior ou Especialista.
  • Proficiência avançada em Node.js e JavaScript/TypeScript para construção de APIs e microsserviços.
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e arquitetura de Agentes Autônomos ou Sistemas de Automação complexos.
  • Conhecimento e experiência prática com o Model Context Protocol (MCP) para comunicação entre agentes/sistemas.
  • Experiência sólida com a AWS Cloud, especialmente em serviços Serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, S3, API Gateway).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de Microsserviços e padrões de comunicação assíncrona.
  • Experiência com Docker e/ou orquestração de containers (ECS/EKS) na AWS.
  • Vivência com metodologia Ágil (Scrum/Kanban) e ferramentas de controle de versão (Git).
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em modelo híbrido 3x2: 3 dias em Sousas/Campinas ou Barueri/SP e 2 dias em modelo home office. Para moradores das demais localidades full remoto.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) e otimização de prompts (Prompt Engineering).
  • Conhecimento em outras ferramentas de orquestração de workflows (e.g., AWS Step Functions).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) como Terraform ou CloudFormation/CDK.
  • Certificações AWS (Ex: AWS Developer Associate, AWS Solutions Architect Associate).
Fazendo Parte Do Time, Você Terá SuperBenefícios Como
  • Flexibilidade de horário: podemos adaptar às mudanças do dia a dia, contanto que os objetivos sejam alcançados.
  • Ajuda de custo para os dias em home office: apoio para trabalhar no conforto do seu lar.

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenos e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de Campinas. Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024 com diversas senioridades na estrutura.Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto as áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);

// Diferenciais:

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

// Modelo de trabalho:

  • Presencial em Campinas e proximidades.

  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar. Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:

Qual a missão do Cargo?

O objetivo desse cargo de DevOps - Cloud/SRE é exercer um papel tático e operacional para garantir que as escolhas tecnológicas e as abordagens de integração entre sistemas a serem utilizadas estão alinhados e são compatíveis com a visão estratégica da arquitetura corporativa. Definição de arquitetura, homologação e sustentação de soluções (skin in the game) em conjunto com o time de engenharia. Desenvolver processos/automações, criar monitoramentos que previnam/antecipem problemas, além de realizar a implantação de soluções e extrair relatórios de custos.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?
  • Através de ferramentas e procedimentos, somos responsáveis pelo planejamento e implantação das soluções de alta tecnologia com objetivo de proporcionar resiliência, segurança e performance em ambientes Cloud dentro de um contexto de Platform Engineering.
  • Somos uma equipe aberta e focada, alinhados a uma cultura de inovação e agilidade, estamos sempre em contato com as mais diversas áreas (engenharia, pré-venda, comercial…), compartilhando conhecimentos e expondo os desafios que são propostos no dia a dia.
  • Enfrentamos os mais diversos desafios, inerentes de uma stack tecnológica de alto nível e inovadora, onde frequentemente são utilizadas tecnologias e estratégias novas (sim, nós somos early adopters).
  • We rock!
Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?
  • Conhecimento em soluções de Cloud públicas (AWS/GCP), containers (docker), orquestração (kubernetes);
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI);
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura, implantação e operação de ambientes de missão crítica em nuvem;
  • Experiência com monitoramento de ambientes (Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana);
  • Experiência em linux (serviços, troubleshooting);
  • Infraestrutura como código (terraform, helm);
  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de scripts, exemplo: python e shell;
  • Redes (segmentação, ferramentas de debug, VPN);
Quais serão os requisitos diferenciais para este cargo?
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Conhecimentos em APIs e REST;
  • Gerenciamento de logs (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana);
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Configuração como código (chef, Ansible).

Qualificações mínimas:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Engenharia de Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de sistemas embarcados com C/C++ ou Python.
  • Linux Embarcado:
    • Experiência prática no desenvolvimento e personalização de distribuições Linux para sistemas embarcados (por exemplo, Yocto, Buildroot).
    • Conhecimento de configuração do kernel, árvores de dispositivos e drivers para integração com hardware específico.

  • Conhecimento de inteligência artificial aplicada ao campo.

HOSPITAL CARE

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Atuamos para melhorar o acesso a saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e para fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

title: Product Security Engineer
description:
Toradex is a global company strongly focused on engineering & technology. We’re powered by a diverse & uniquely gifted workforce. We pursue the best people to propel our innovative vision of embedded computing and IoT. If you’re interested in being a driving force at an agile technology company, engineering clever computing solutions & helping other companies bring their products to life, we should talk.

Overview

As a Product Security Engineer at Toradex, you’ll be responsible for the implementation, validation, and maintenance of security features in Toradex’s embedded software stack. That means hands‑on, low‑level work with bootloaders, Linux kernel security features, secure software updates and more.

We aim to make embedded software development easy and approachable, which means that our engineers have to go beyond just feature enablement. Your work will involve making the developer experience of working with low‑level security features as smooth as it possibly can be. You’ll work on systems used in critical industries like healthcare, industrial automation, and robotics.

Responsibilities
  • Security feature enablement: Bring up security features on new hardware. Every new product we release, we strive to have a uniform, straightforward experience for enabling basic hardware security features like secure boot, ARM TrustZone/ OP-TEE , and hardware‑backed encryption.
  • System-level hardening: Toradex maintains Torizon OS, a secure, production‑ready embedded Linux OS. Making sure that security features fit into the whole stack, and that configurations are secure‑by‑default for the most common and supported workflows is a key part of the job. Understanding how everything fits together is a must.
  • Vulnerability management: Monitor upstream CVEs, assess their impact on Toradex products and their likely impact on Toradex customers' products. Apply patches and mitigations. Help draft security advisories and write VEX documents. Work on and maintain internal tooling for vulnerability management.
  • Security testing and automation: Automate test coverage of security features. Familiarity with LAVA or other hardware‑in‑the‑loop embedded testing methodologies and frameworks is a strong plus.
Qualifications and Experience
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in embedded systems security or adjacent areas (e.g. Linux security engineering)
  • Hands‑on experience with bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot), kernel security features, and embedded Linux distributions/build systems (Yocto/OpenEmbedded, buildroot, etc.)
  • Solid C/C++ coding and debugging skills
  • Experience with automating security checks in CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of threat modeling/risk modeling methodologies and how they relate to regulatory and standards compliance is a plus
  • Knowledge of security evaluation and analysis tools like fuzzers and static analysis tools is a plus
What we offer
  • Agile, globally oriented and intercultural corporate culture.
  • Work on the latest hardware technology with early access to major SoC vendor
  • Enjoy a flat hierarchy where you may truly shape our hardware and software offerings
  • Count on a diverse team of experienced hardware and software engineers
  • Variety of knowledge sharing, training and self‑development opportunities
  • The opportunity to play a key role in shaping your own work processes and your work environment.
  • Contemporary employment conditions, modern office space and a flexible working environment.
  • Opportunities for your personal development.
  • Meal allowance (flash card)
  • Health and dental care
  • Parking space
  • Anniversary day off

Toradex is a leader in embedded computing, serving innovative products to industrial, medical, automotive & IoT companies creating feature‑rich & intelligent systems for demanding applications, e.g. supercars, self‑driving tractors, patient monitoring systems – to name a few.

We provide effective & robust embedded computing solutions and strive for the best development experience in the industry with a focus on intelligent hardware design, innovative software solutions & free comprehensive support. Our relationship with our customers ensures that we all succeed and it allows us to participate in the realization of incredible new products. Our products are directly sold to more than 3'000 industrial customers in over 70 different countries worldwide.

A Turner & Townsend promove oportunidades iguais e inclusão para todos os funcionários. Esperamos candidaturas de todos os setores da comunidade.

  • – Buscar ativamente novas ferramentas, frameworks e boas práticas para evoluir o produto e o próprio conhecimento.

  • – Colocar-se no lugar de quem utiliza a aplicação, garantindo usabilidade, acessibilidade e boa experiência.

description:
Overview

DESCRIÇÃO
DENTISTA Avaliador(a) (Banco de Talentos). Você é dentista, ama cuidar de pessoas, e gosta de metas, desafios e resultados? Transforme sorrisos e resultados conosco. Na Odontoclinic, buscamos Dentistas Avaliadores(as) com olhar clínico e espírito comercial, que encantem no atendimento e entreguem experiências únicas para o paciente.

O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui

  • Um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e com alto astral
  • Treinamentos constantes e ferramentas para o seu desenvolvimento
  • Reconhecimento por desempenho e oportunidades reais de crescimento
  • Remuneração atrativa com base em meritocracia
  • Propósito: transformar a vida das pessoas através do sorriso

Procuramos Alguém Com

  • Formação em Odontologia com CRO ativo
  • Comunicação empática, segura e persuasiva
  • Facilidade para construir conexão e gerar confiança com o paciente
  • Capacidade de apresentar planos de tratamento de forma clara e estratégica
  • Energia, foco em metas e atitude de dono(a)
  • Vivência com vendas será um diferencial, mas vontade de aprender conta muito

Suas Principais Missões

  • Realizar avaliações iniciais com excelência e atenção genuína
  • Apresentar planos de tratamento alinhados às necessidades do paciente
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com a equipe para atingir metas e gerar encantamento
  • Ser um elo entre o cuidado clínico e o sucesso do paciente na jornada odontológica

Se você acredita que excelência clínica e performance podem andar juntas, essa é a sua chance de fazer parte de algo grandioso. Vem ser Odontocliniquer e crescer com a gente!

Sobre a ODONTOCLINIC

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Tudo isso é possível porque temos um time incrível por trás de cada resultado. Somos a primeira rede de franquias odontológicas do país e, ao longo dos anos, recebemos prêmios como o Troféu Excelência em Franchising da ABF e reconhecimentos como uma das Melhores Franquias do Brasil pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios. Fomos eleitos, por seis anos consecutivos, como a clínica com o melhor atendimento do Brasil no segmento odontológico pelo Reclame Aqui.

Aqui, valorizamos o desenvolvimento de pessoas como caminho para resultados sustentáveis. Investimos em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui. Vem ser Odontocliniquer!

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar. Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:

Qual a missão do Cargo?

Na Sensedia, acreditamos que conexões movem o mundo digital. Nosso ferramenta de iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) combina o poder do Apache Camel com uma interface low-code que acelera o desenvolvimento de integrações modernas, seguras e escaláveis. Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora Sênior, com sólidos conhecimentos em integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento Java, para atuar na migração de pipelines entre plataformas iPaas.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de integrações complexas na plataforma Sensedia Integrations.
  • Planejar e executar a migração de pipelines entre plataformas, garantindo performance, governança e boas práticas.
  • Definir e aplicar padrões de integração (EIPs), boas práticas de resiliência (circuit breaker, fallback) e observabilidade.
  • Apoiar e orientar desenvolvedores Pleno e Júnior, promovendo boas práticas de arquitetura e codificação.
  • Atuar em conjunto com arquitetos na definição de padrões de integração, segurança e transformação de dados.
  • Garantir segurança (OAuth 2.0, JWT) e conformidade com especificações OpenAPI.
  • Trabalhar em integrações assíncronas (mensageria, eventos) e síncronas (REST/SOAP).
  • Contribuir com a evolução da base de código Java e com boas práticas de engenharia.
Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?
  • Experiência sólida em integração de sistemas, iPaaS ou ESB (preferencialmente Apache Camel).
  • Forte domínio em Java, Spring Boot, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Experiência com EIPs (Enterprise Integration Patterns) e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Conhecimentos em mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.), MongoDB, REST/SOAP APIs e OAuth 2.0/JWT.
  • Experiência com observabilidade, logging estruturado e tracing distribuído.
  • Vivência em tratamento de erros, resiliência e boas práticas de logging.
  • Familiaridade com transformação de dados (JOLT, JSONata, XSLT) e especificações OpenAPI.
  • Experiência com testes unitários.
  • Experiência com Docker e Docker Compose.
  • Experiência com design e desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência com Git.
  • Experiência em design patterns.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações cloud native.
  • Conhecimento nos recursos AWS: IAM, S3, EC2, Lambda, SQS, SNS, ECS, EKS, RDS, DynamoDB, Event Bridge.
  • Conhecimento em API Gateway.
Quais serão os requisitos diferenciais para este cargo?
  • Experiência com Apache Camel.
  • Conhecimento em criptografia simétrica e assimétrica.
  • Experiência com engenharia de performance e observabilidade distribuída.
  • Conhecimento em Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em Golang.
  • Conhecimento em Javascript.
Aqui você vai encontrar:
  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

#WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers. Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos e ambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão é mapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade, tudo bem? =)

*Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados - Lei n° 13.709/2018

About AB InBev

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

  • Advanced knowledge of software testing concepts (testability, regression, unit, integration, stress, test automation);
  • Good communication skills in English (written and spoken);

More about you
  • You’re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building up world class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and continuously seek improvements for processes and solutions;

  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes on the final result.
Bonus / Plus Skills
  • AI Development Tools & AI-based IDEs : Experience using AI-powered tools to enhance productivity.
What We Offer
  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms
EEO Statement

We conduct confidential surveys to better understand & ensure we provide equal opportunity throughout our end-to-end recruitment process. Individuals seeking employment at ABInBev are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file.

Your personal information will be processed in accordance with the law for the purposes of managing ABINBEV’s recruitment related activities, which include setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing the results thereto, and as is otherwise needed in the recruitment and hiring processes.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award‑winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

Why Join Us

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you’ll play a key role in modernizing a high‑impact geospatial platform by helping transition from ArcGIS to an open‑source stack. During this 3‑month project, you’ll build end‑to‑end solutions that empower users with actionable environmental insights, while collaborating closely across backend and frontend teams to shape scalable, data‑driven features.

What You Will Do
  • Work on a 3‑month project.
  • Build and maintain frontend features for a geospatial platform using a modern JavaScript/TypeScript framework (React).
  • Integrate complex REST APIs serving geospatial data, including GeoJSON features, map tiles, and image PNGs.
  • Swap and configure basemap tile providers, such as OpenMapTiles, Mapbox, or Esri.
  • Implement complete features including user authentication, data upload, and client‑side state management for map interactions.
  • Collaborate with the backend team on geospatial concepts such as BBOX, vector features, raster tiles, and projections.
Must Haves
  • 5+ years of experience with .NET or Python.
  • Expertise in a modern JavaScript/TypeScript framework (React).
  • Proven experience with frontend mapping libraries, especially Leaflet and/or Mapbox GL JS.
  • Strong ability to consume and integrate complex REST APIs serving geospatial data (GeoJSON features, map tiles, and image PNGs).
  • Experience swapping and configuring basemap tile providers (OpenMapTiles, Mapbox, Esri).
  • Experience building complete features, including user authentication, data upload, and client‑side state management for map interactions.
  • A solid understanding of geospatial concepts (BBOX, vector features, raster tiles, projections).
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.
Nice to Haves
  • Experience with cloud deployment and provisioning, specifically on Azure.
  • Previous experience migrating services away from an Esri/ArcGIS stack (ImageServer, FeatureServer).
  • Knowledge of open‑source basemap providers like OpenMapTiles or Planet OSM.
  • Experience working with modern open‑source geospatial stack components such as TiTiler, FastAPI, and COG.
  • Ability to handle large‑scale raster and vector data efficiently for live frontend applications.
  • Experience with full backend data pipeline ownership, including database tuning, data conversion, API performance, and cloud infrastructure.
Perks and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation: We match your growing skills and contributions with competitive USD‑based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.

  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work‑life balance, with the option to work from home or in the office.

title: Data Engineer_ Snowflake
description:
Job Description: Senior Snowflake Data Engineer (Migration & Modelling)

Location: Brazil/ Costa Rica (Remote)

Job Type: Contract / Project-Based (Staff Augmentation)

Note : Need to support PST timings


Project Summary:

We are seeking highly skilled Snowflake Data Engineers to act as augmented members of a client's data team. You will be responsible for the hands-on execution of a complex, end-to-end data platform migration to Snowflake.

This is a hands-on execution role. You will be expected to integrate seamlessly with the existing team and take direct ownership of critical migration and data modelling tasks to accelerate the project's delivery. This is a complex transformation, not a simple "lift-and-shift."


Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Modelling & Architecture:
  • Collaborate with the client's BI and Data Science teams to define data requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement conceptual, logical, and physical data models (e.g., Dimensional, Star Schema) optimized for Snowflake.
  • Develop and document data models, data definitions, and data flow diagrams for the new environment.
  • Data Migration & Engineering:
  • Execute the hands-on technical migration of data from legacy systems to the Snowflake Data Cloud
  • Engineer, build, and optimize robust ELT/ETL data pipelines within Snowflake (using SnowSQL, Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, etc.).
  • Implement and automate data quality checks and validation processes to ensure data integrity and accuracy.
  • Team Integration & Delivery:
  • Integrate directly with the client's data team, participating in all relevant project routines and workflows.
  • Take ownership of assigned migration and modeling tasks, delivering high-quality, production-ready code and models with minimal supervision.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to data migration, modeling, and pipeline performance.
  • Create clear technical documentation for all developed assets (models, pipelines, etc.).


Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Expert-level Snowflake: Deep, proven, hands-on experience with the Snowflake platform (architecture, SnowSQL, Snowpipe, performance optimization).
  • Expert-level Data Modeling: 4+ years of dedicated experience in data modeling (Dimensional, Relational) and data warehousing architecture.
  • Proven Data Migration: 4+ years of experience executing complex, large-scale data warehouse migrations (non-lift-and-shift).
  • Strong Data Engineering: Proficiency in building data pipelines (ELT/ETL) using SQL and modern tools (e.g., dbt, Python, or similar).
  • Execution Focus: A proven "do-er" with the ability to integrate into an existing team and deliver on complex technical tasks independently.
  • BI / Analytics Acumen: Strong understanding of how data models are consumed by BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.) and Data Science workloads.

A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.

As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .
  • Flight Test Oversight: Managing all phases of flight test campaigns, including pre-flight preparation, test execution, and rigorous post-flight analysis .
  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

title: Capital Agents
description:
We’re Expanding Our Global Capital Agent Network – Join Magnum Equities as an Independent Capital Agent


Remote | Global | Commission-Based | #PrivateEquity #CapitalRaising #InvestmentOpportunities #CapitalAgent #Agent #Broker #InvestmentBanker #PrivateMarkets #VentureCapital #Entrepreneurship


Are you a capital introducer, private banker, independent dealmaker, ultra-networker, or connected investment professional looking to monetize your network?


Magnum is seeking experienced Capital Agents to join our global sourcing network. These independent agents will facilitate capital to Magnum Equities and earn 2% commission on successfully funded partnership capital placements, from fiat currency to crypto currency.


Capital Agent – Independent Investment Sourcing Partner


Location: Global | Remote

Full | Part-time or Side gig with your current job


Industry: You can be of any industry sector background, early/mid/or late in your career, having a capital network of partnership investment prospects that desire high ROI via profit share in Magnum’s global real estate and business equities assets growth forward, and large-scale social impact.


Commission: 2% of Capital Raised


About Magnum Equities


Magnum is foremost a mass capital investment partnership platform, capital raise platform for SME's, and mass social impact/empowerment powerhouse. Magnum's main pillars: Real Estate Assets Partners | Tech/Business Equity Partners | Precious Metals | Sukuk (Marabaha) enabling Shariah compliant capital placement investment from micro to macro capital partners, via “Magnum Equities Partnership Tokenization". Enabling globally democratized - low barrier to entry (min 50 Euros/token) - investment, empowering individuals to large institutional capital placement participation in Magnum’s global portfolio rather than being limited to only a specific single asset, optimizing short/medium/long term (3-5yrs), ROI (3X/5X/10X/100X/2500X+), and abatement of any singular asset downside. Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Micro to Macro partnerships via fractional partnership profit share tokenization on blockchain via our RWA/PropTech blockchain/fintech partner portal.


Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment


What We Offer


  • Attractive transparent commission model - Unique Agent link to use | Earnings wallet
  • Leverage Magnum’s professionally curated pitch decks, site resources etc
  • Flexible, remote-first role – ideal for global professionals
  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance
  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management


*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.


This mass individual empowerment and expansive social impact integration is a purposeful and very important component to us at Magnum, in keeping with our 125yr tradition, where democratized opportunity for all, at every socio-economic level, every geo-location in developed and under-developed nations, can raise the ‘economic base of the societal pyramid’ in every region. Where capitalism can co-exist without displacement, with equality, dignity, respect, levelling the contentious playing field between the “have’s and the have not’s”.


Commission Example (2% on capital intake from each partner capital placement with Magnum)


Raise 1,000 EU  Earn 20 EU- Micro partners/investors (global individuals)


Raise $100,000 EU  Earn 2,000 EU – Individuals | HNW | Small fund portfolios

Easy Next Step

Register as Capital Agent directly on Magnum's website:

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We deliver across borders.

  • We bring the best ideas to life.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.

  • Seguir metodologias SAP (ASAP, Activate, Agile) durante a execução dos projetos.


Qualificações


  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Consultor SAP PLM.
  • Experiência prática em projetos de migração ECC → S/4HANA.
  • Sólido conhecimento em DMS, ECM e integrações de processos PLM.
  • Entendimento de gestão de dados mestres e seu papel no PLM.
  • Experiência com ciclos de teste (UT, IT, UAT).
  • Inglês avançado ou superior.
  • Espanhol intermediário ou superior.
  • Conhecimento de aplicativos Fiori para PLM no S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de migração de dados (LTMC, LSMW, SAP Migration Cockpit).
  • Familiaridade com SAP Solution Manager para documentação e testes.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Capacidade de atuar em equipes internacionais e multifuncionais.


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo(a) a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores


  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.


Como se Candidatar

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Physics with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.

  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.

  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender

Junte-se a nós!

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Data Analyst (Sales Focus)
description:
About YipitData:

YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact.

We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.

With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.


Why You Should Apply NOW:

  • The Data Feeds team manages the data feeds business at YipitData. We partner with systematic and quantamental investment firms by providing access to alternative data for investment analytics and model development.
  • Become part of a growing team where your ideas and collaboration will have a direct impact on how we deliver value to top-tier investment firms.


About The Role:

YipitData seeks a proactive, analytically minded Sales Engineer with +2 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role will directly influence the growth of our data feed revenue. As a Sales Engineer, you will provide our clients with operational and quantitative development support , enabling them to utilize and evaluate YipitData’s data feeds effectively.


We expect East Coast work hours.


As Our Sales Engineer, You Will:

  • Provide operational support during client onboarding, with a strong focus on the setup, configuration, and integration of complex data feeds (40% daily focus).
  • Partner closely with Sales to drive product adoption by delivering demonstrations, analyses, and explanations of complex data feeds to clients.
  • Address client queries and maintain strong relationships by ensuring our data solutions align closely with clients’ investment strategies.
  • Develop quantitative documentation, scripts, and use-case examples to facilitate client evaluations, integrations, and ongoing data usage (60% daily focus).
  • Collaborate with Product to improve product features based on client feedback.


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline or finance-related field.
  • Experience in financial markets (Nice to have) ; excellent client-facing communication skills.
  • Experience working with US clients is highly preferred
  • Proficiency in Python (preferred), SQL, Databricks (preferred), Jupyter, and AWS (Knowledge focused on answering clients’ questions).


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.
